# Third-party loader source provenance

The `source/` files in this directory originate from:
https://github.com/MetalSyntax/ios-loader-boilerplate (upstream `master`).

They have been modified for Iron Man 2: dynamic VM slide, contiguous image allocation, RBS1 validation, import bounds and fail-closed behavior.

**Licensing unresolved:** No root `LICENSE` file was found when checked on 2026-10-29. Public source availability does not itself grant redistribution rights. Before public redistribution or a public binary release, obtain permission or verify an applicable license from the upstream author. This project is kept experimental/private until clarified.

No original Iron Man 2 game binary, iOS assets, Apple libraries or proprietary firmware are included.
